findings.text: [C]: a little night scene with stars, a gold crescent and soft purple hills reads like a bedtime picture book, the warmest and safest icon here; but its 4 is tiny and the name truncates to "Paint by Mo...".
[B]: a big bright crescent holding a clear 3 on deep night is calm and easy to spot at a glance, and "Moonlight" fits under it whole.
[A]: the full moon covered in purple blotches looks bruised or spotty rather than painted, which is less cozy than the others; the 4 is small and the icon nearly vanishes into the dark screen.
[D]: the big 6 is the clearest number of all, but the dark green-black hills feel cold and the name "Paint by Heart" breaks the moon/night story the others share.
All four dark-background icons sink into the dimmed home screen next to the bright neighbors, so only the moon shapes in [B] and [C] catch the eye at night.
